name: KAST Card
summary: KAST is a stablecoin account and Visa card for spending USDT and USDC in 170+ countries. The free Standard plan pays 1.5% cashback in USD with no card spend fee, while paid Premium and Private memberships raise cashback to 2% and 3%. A government ID check is required before you can transact.

fees.topup: Free (0% on top-ups and USD card spend)

limits.dailySpend: No fixed card limit (security checks apply)
limits.monthlySpend: No fixed card limit (security checks apply)
limits.atmWithdrawal: US$250 per withdrawal; 3 withdrawals or US$750 per 24 hours

kyc.notes: KAST requires identity verification with a government-issued ID before you can transact. The check is done in the app and takes a few minutes.

faq.question: Can I use KAST without KYC?
faq.answer: No. KAST requires identity verification with a government-issued ID before you can transact.

faq.question: How much cashback does the KAST card pay?
faq.answer: 1.5% on the free Standard plan, 2% on Premium (US$1,000/year) and 3% on Private (US$10,000/year), paid in USD. Premium and Private also earn KAST Points.

faq.question: What fees does the KAST card charge?
faq.answer: There is no fee on top-ups, USD card spending or Apple Pay/Google Pay. Non-USD purchases carry an FX fee of 0.5% to 1.75% depending on country and currency, ATM withdrawals cost US$3 + 2%, and a declined transaction for insufficient balance costs US$0.50.

faq.question: What can I spend with the KAST card?
faq.answer: KAST supports USDT, USDC, PYUSD and RLUSD, and converts other deposited crypto such as SOL, BTC, ETH and XRP to stablecoins. Spending goes through Visa, including Apple Pay and Google Pay.

faq.question: Is KAST available in my country?
faq.answer: KAST says it serves 170+ countries but does not publish the list. The identity check in the app shows the supported countries; if yours is not listed, KAST is not available to you.

availabilityNotes: KAST says its account and card are available in 170+ countries but does not publish the list. During sign-up, the identity check shows the supported countries: if yours is not listed, KAST is not available to you. Restricted locations are not published either; they include sanctioned and embargoed countries and can change without notice. Dual citizens may pass verification with an ID from a supported country.
howToGet: Download the KAST app and create an account.
Complete identity verification with a government-issued ID. Pick your country from the supported list; if it is missing, KAST is not available to you.
Fund your account with USDT or USDC on a supported network, or send other crypto to be converted to stablecoins.
Use your included virtual cards right away, or order a physical card (free on Standard, plus US$40 delivery).
Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay and start spending. Upgrade to Premium or Private only if the extra cashback covers the annual fee.
